Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). did_you_know.fact: On December 13, 1959: Archbishop Makarios III becomes the first President of Cyprus.
On December 13, 1642: Abel Tasman is the first recorded European to sight New Zealand.
December 13 is observed as Sailor's Day (Brazil).

On December 13, 1972: Apollo program: Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt begin the third and final extra-vehicular activity (EVA) or "Moonwalk" of Apollo 17. To date they are the last humans to set foot on the Moon.
